common.updatedBody: This document is provided for general informational purposes. Review it and contact us if you have questions.
common.footerNote: If you need signed or jurisdiction-specific versions, we recommend reviewing with legal counsel.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the platform and liability limitations.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance
acceptance.body: By accessing or using the platform, you agree to these terms. If you disagree, do not use the service.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must have legal capacity to use the service. If you are underage, use the service with guardian consent.

use.title: 3. Acceptable use
use.body: You agree to use the platform lawfully and not attempt to compromise security, disrupt the service, or abuse features.

health.title: 4. Health information
health.body: HealthCore does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment. Recommendations and estimates are informational only.

accounts.title: 5. Accounts and access
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping credentials confidential and for all activity under your account.

payments.title: 6. Payments (if applicable)
payments.body: Some features may require payment. Prices and plan conditions will be shown before purchase.

ip.title: 7. Intellectual property
ip.body: Software, trademarks, and content belong to their respective owners. No license is granted beyond normal service usage.

termination.title: 8. Suspension or termination
termination.body: We may suspend access for violations, fraud, or security risks. You may stop using the service at any time.

contact.title: 9. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact us through the channels available in the platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data and what choices you have.

summary.title: 1. Summary
summary.body: We collect minimal data to operate the service (e.g., email and preferences). You can use the demo without an account.

dataWeCollect.title: 2. Data we collect
dataWeCollect.body: Depending on usage, we may collect: account data, meal logs, metrics (weight/height), and technical data (browser, error events).

howWeUse.title: 3. How we use data
howWeUse.body: To provide the service, improve the experience, maintain security, and (if applicable) enable support with a nutritionist.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing
sharing.body: We only share data when you request it (e.g., with a chosen nutritionist) or when required to operate the service (infrastructure providers).

retention.title: 5. Retention
retention.body: We retain data as needed to operate your account and meet obligations. You may request deletion depending on product availability.

security.title: 6. Security
security.body: We apply reasonable controls to protect information. No system is 100% secure; avoid reusing passwords.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion where applicable. Exact options vary by region and product status.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related requests, contact us through the channels available in the platform.
